adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.short_desc: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.
adaptability.desc: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.
adaptability.flavor_text: Powers up moves of the same type.

aerilate.name: Aerilate
aerilate.short_desc: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Flying moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
aerilate.desc: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Flying-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.short_desc: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.
aftermath.desc: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.
aftermath.flavor_text: Damages the foe landing the finishing hit.

air-lock.name: Air Lock
air-lock.short_desc: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
air-lock.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Cloud Nine.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.short_desc: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.
analytic.desc: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their power when it moves last in a turn. Future Sight and Doom Desire are unaffected.
analytic.flavor_text: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

anger-point.name: Anger Point
anger-point.short_desc: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.
anger-point.desc: Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages. This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a Substitute.
anger-point.flavor_text: Raises Attack upon taking a critical hit.

anger-shell.name: Anger Shell
anger-shell.short_desc: When the Pokémon's HP drops below half, Anger Shell lowers its Defense and Special Defense but its Attack, Special Attack and Speed are raised.
anger-shell.desc: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
anger-shell.flavor_text: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.short_desc: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.
anticipation.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified. The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move. Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as Future Sight, and moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, count as their listed types. Counter, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.

arena-trap.name: Arena Trap
arena-trap.short_desc: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.
arena-trap.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to Levitate or Magnet Rise, are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

armor-tail.name: Armor Tail
armor-tail.short_desc: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.
armor-tail.desc: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
armor-tail.flavor_text: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

aroma-veil.name: Aroma Veil
aroma-veil.short_desc: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.
aroma-veil.desc: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.
aroma-veil.flavor_text: Protects allies from attacks that limit their move choices.

as-one-glastrier.name: As One
as-one-glastrier.flavor_text: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex’s Unnerve Ability and Glastrier’s Chilling Neigh Ability.

as-one-spectrier.name: As One
as-one-spectrier.flavor_text: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex’s Unnerve Ability and Spectrier’s Grim Neigh Ability.

aura-break.name: Aura Break
aura-break.short_desc: Makes Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types.
aura-break.desc: While this Pokémon is on the field, Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types to 2/3 their power, rather than strengthening them.
aura-break.flavor_text: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed.

bad-dreams.name: Bad Dreams
bad-dreams.short_desc: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.
bad-dreams.desc: Opposing Pokémon take 1/8 of their maximum HP in damage after each turn while they are asleep.

ball-fetch.name: Ball Fetch
ball-fetch.short_desc: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
ball-fetch.desc: At any time after the first Poké Ball is thrown and fails to catch a Pokémon, at the end of a turn, if a Pokémon with Ball Fetch is on the field and not holding another item, it will pick up the same type of ball as the first one thrown.
ball-fetch.flavor_text: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

battery.name: Battery
battery.short_desc: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.
battery.desc: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.
battery.flavor_text: Powers up ally Pokémon’s special moves.

battle-armor.name: Battle Armor
battle-armor.desc: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Shell Armor.

battle-bond.name: Battle Bond
battle-bond.short_desc: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent. Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.
battle-bond.desc: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent. Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Greninja.
battle-bond.flavor_text: Defeating an opposing Pokémon strengthens the Pokémon’s bond with its Trainer, and it becomes Ash-Greninja. Water Shuriken gets more powerful.

beads-of-ruin.name: Beads of Ruin
beads-of-ruin.short_desc: Lowers Special Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
beads-of-ruin.desc: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
beads-of-ruin.flavor_text: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

beast-boost.name: Beast Boost
beast-boost.short_desc: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.
beast-boost.desc: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.
beast-boost.flavor_text: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.short_desc: Raises this Pokémon's Special Attack by one stage every time its HP drops below half.
berserk.desc: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move that causes its HP to drop below 50%, its Special Attack rises by one stage.
berserk.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to become half or less.

big-pecks.name: Big Pecks
big-pecks.desc: This Pokémon's Defense cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Defense modifiers through Heart Swap or Guard Swap.
big-pecks.flavor_text: Protects the Pokémon from Defense-lowering attacks.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.short_desc: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
blaze.desc: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
blaze.flavor_text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.short_desc: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.
bulletproof.desc: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.
bulletproof.flavor_text: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

cheek-pouch.name: Cheek Pouch
cheek-pouch.short_desc: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.
cheek-pouch.desc: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.
cheek-pouch.flavor_text: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.

chilling-neigh.name: Chilling Neigh
chilling-neigh.short_desc: Boosts Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
chilling-neigh.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
chilling-neigh.flavor_text: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.desc: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
chlorophyll.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed in sunshine.

clear-body.name: Clear Body
clear-body.short_desc: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
clear-body.desc: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.

cloud-nine.name: Cloud Nine
cloud-nine.short_desc: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
cloud-nine.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.

color-change.name: Color Change
color-change.short_desc: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.
color-change.desc: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move. If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden. The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a Substitute will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as Spikes. This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack. In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.

comatose.name: Comatose
comatose.short_desc: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep.
comatose.desc: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep. It cannot be given another status ailment; it's unaffected by Yawn; it can use Sleep Talk; and so on.
comatose.flavor_text: It’s always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack without waking up.

commander.name: Commander
commander.short_desc: Goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.
commander.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
commander.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.short_desc: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
competitive.desc: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
competitive.flavor_text: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat when a stat is lowered.

compound-eyes.name: Compound Eyes
compound-eyes.desc: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy. This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold). Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.

contrary.name: Contrary
contrary.desc: Whenever this Pokémon's stats would be raised, they are instead lowered by the same amount, and vice versa.
contrary.flavor_text: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.short_desc: This Pokémon can inflict poison on Poison and Steel Pokémon.
corrosion.desc: This Pokémon's moves and item ignore the usual immunity of Poison and Steel Pokémon when attempting to inflict poison.
corrosion.flavor_text: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it’s a Steel or Poison type.

costar.name: Costar
costar.short_desc: Copies ally's stat changes on entering battle.
costar.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s stat changes.
costar.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

cotton-down.name: Cotton Down
cotton-down.short_desc: When Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
cotton-down.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stats of all Pokémon except itself.
cotton-down.flavor_text: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

cud-chew.name: Cud Chew
cud-chew.short_desc: Causes the Pokémon to reuse an already consumed Berry at the end of the next turn.
cud-chew.desc: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
cud-chew.flavor_text: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

curious-medicine.name: Curious Medicine
curious-medicine.short_desc: Resets all stat changes upon entering battlefield.
curious-medicine.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.
curious-medicine.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

cursed-body.name: Cursed Body
cursed-body.short_desc: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.
cursed-body.desc: Moves that hit this Pokémon have a 30% chance of being Disabled afterward.
cursed-body.flavor_text: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.

cute-charm.name: Cute Charm
cute-charm.short_desc: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.
cute-charm.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.

damp.name: Damp
damp.short_desc: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
damp.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, Self-Destruct and Explosion will fail and Aftermath will not take effect.

dancer.name: Dancer
dancer.short_desc: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.
dancer.desc: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.
dancer.flavor_text: When another Pokémon uses a dance move, it can use a dance move following it regardless of its Speed.

dark-aura.name: Dark Aura
dark-aura.short_desc: Strengthens Dark moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
dark-aura.desc: Strengthens Dark moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
dark-aura.flavor_text: Powers up each Pokémon’s Dark-type moves.

dauntless-shield.name: Dauntless Shield
dauntless-shield.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
dauntless-shield.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

dazzling.name: Dazzling
dazzling.short_desc: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.
dazzling.desc: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.
dazzling.flavor_text: Surprises the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.

defeatist.name: Defeatist
defeatist.short_desc: Halves Attack and Special Attack at 50% max HP or less.
defeatist.desc: This Pokémon's Attack and Special Attack are halved when it has half its HP or less.
defeatist.flavor_text: Lowers stats when HP becomes half or less.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.short_desc: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.
defiant.desc: When any of this Pokémon's stats are lowered, its Attack rises by two stages. If multiple stats are lowered at once, this ability takes effect with each stat lowered.
defiant.flavor_text: When its stats are lowered its Attack increases.

delta-stream.name: Delta Stream
delta-stream.short_desc: Creates a mysterious air current, which cannot be replaced and causes moves to never be super effective against Flying Pokémon.
delta-stream.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes a mysterious air current. A mysterious air current causes moves to not be super effective against Flying; they do neutral damage instead. Anticipation and Stealth Rock are not affected. The mysterious air current ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Desolate Land and Primordial Sea. Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effect of a mysterious air current, but will not allow the weather to be changed.
delta-stream.flavor_text: Affects weather and eliminates all of the Flying type’s weaknesses.

desolate-land.name: Desolate Land
desolate-land.short_desc: Creates extremely harsh sunlight, which has all the properties of Sunny Day, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Water moves to fail.
desolate-land.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes extremely harsh sunlight. Extremely harsh sunlight has all the properties of Sunny Day and also causes damaging Water moves to fail. Extremely harsh sunlight ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Delta Stream and Primordial Sea. Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effects of extremely harsh sunlight, including allowing Water moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.
desolate-land.flavor_text: Affects weather and nullifies any Water-type attacks.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.short_desc: Prevents the first instance of battle damage.
disguise.desc: If this Pokémon is in its Disguised Form and takes damage from a move, it switches to its Busted Form and the damage is prevented. Other effects are not prevented. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Mimikyu.
disguise.flavor_text: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

download.name: Download
download.short_desc: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.
download.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, its Attack or Special Attack, whichever corresponds to its opponents' weaker total defensive stat, rises one stage. In the event of a tie, Special Attack is raised. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle.
download.flavor_text: Adjusts power according to the foe’s ability.

dragonize.name: Dragonize
dragonize.short_desc: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
dragonize.desc: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
dragonize.flavor_text: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

dragons-maw.name: Dragon’s Maw
dragons-maw.desc: Increases the power of Dragon-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.short_desc: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
drizzle.desc: The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

drought.name: Drought
drought.short_desc: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
drought.desc: The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

dry-skin.name: Dry Skin
dry-skin.short_desc: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
dry-skin.desc: This Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn during strong sunlight, but it heals for 1/8 of its HP each turn during rain. This Pokémon takes 1.25× as much damage from Fire-type moves, but whenever a Water move hits it, it heals for 1/4 its maximum HP instead.
dry-skin.flavor_text: Reduces HP if it is hot. Water restores HP.

early-bird.name: Early Bird
early-bird.short_desc: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.
early-bird.desc: This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1. If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.

earth-eater.name: Earth Eater
earth-eater.short_desc: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.
earth-eater.desc: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
earth-eater.flavor_text: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

effect-spore.name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.short_desc: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.
effect-spore.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random. Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.

electric-surge.name: Electric Surge
electric-surge.short_desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.
electric-surge.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.
electric-surge.flavor_text: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

electromorphosis.name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.short_desc: When hit by an attack, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
electromorphosis.desc: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
electromorphosis.flavor_text: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

embody-aspect.name: Embody Aspect
embody-aspect.short_desc: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon
embody-aspect.desc: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon
embody-aspect.flavor_text: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.

emergency-exit.name: Emergency Exit
emergency-exit.short_desc: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.
emergency-exit.desc: After this Pokémon is hit by a move, if that move caused this Pokémon's HP to drop below half, it switches out.
emergency-exit.flavor_text: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

fairy-aura.name: Fairy Aura
fairy-aura.short_desc: Strengthens Fairy moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
fairy-aura.desc: Strengthens Fairy moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
fairy-aura.flavor_text: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.

filter.name: Filter
filter.short_desc: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
filter.desc: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Solid Rock.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.short_desc: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
flame-body.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor.

flare-boost.name: Flare Boost
flare-boost.short_desc: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when burned.
flare-boost.desc: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack when burned.
flare-boost.flavor_text: Powers up special attacks when burned.

flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
flash-fire.short_desc: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
flash-fire.desc: This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves. Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle. This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen. The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled. Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.
flash-fire.flavor_text: Powers up if hit by fire.

flower-gift.name: Flower Gift
flower-gift.short_desc: Increases friendly Pokémon's Attack and Special Defense to 1.5× during strong sunlight.
flower-gift.desc: Friendly Pokémon have 1.5× their Attack and Special Defense during strong sunlight if any friendly Pokémon has this ability. Unlike Forecast, Multitype, and Zen Mode, this ability is not tied to its Pokémon's form change; Cherrim will switch between its forms even if it loses this ability. As such, this ability also works if obtained by a Pokémon other than Cherrim.
flower-gift.flavor_text: Powers up party Pokémon when it is sunny.

flower-veil.name: Flower Veil
flower-veil.short_desc: Protects friendly Grass Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.
flower-veil.desc: Protects friendly Grass Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.
flower-veil.flavor_text: Prevents lowering of ally Grass-type Pokémon’s stats.

fluffy.name: Fluffy
fluffy.short_desc: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.
fluffy.desc: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.
fluffy.flavor_text: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.short_desc: Changes Castform's type and form to match the weather.
forecast.desc: During rain, strong sunlight, or hail, this Pokémon's type changes to Water, Fire, or Ice, respectively, and its form changes to match. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Castform. If the weather ends or becomes anything that does not trigger this ability, or a Pokémon with Air Lock or Cloud Nine enters battle, this Pokémon's type and form revert to their default. If this ability is lost or disabled, this Pokémon cannot change its current type and form until it regains its ability.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.short_desc: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.
forewarn.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers. In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random. Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows: Power | Moves ----: | ----- 160 | One-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold 120 | Counter moves: Counter, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat 80 | Variable power or set damage: Crush Grip, Dragon Rage, Electro Ball, Endeavor, Final Gambit, Flail, Frustration, Grass Knot, Gyro Ball, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Hidden Power, Low Kick, Natural Gift, Night Shade, Psywave, Return, Reversal, Seismic Toss, Sonic Boom, Trump Card, and Wring Out 0 | Any such move not listed
forewarn.flavor_text: Determines what moves the foe has.

friend-guard.name: Friend Guard
friend-guard.short_desc: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.
friend-guard.desc: All friendly Pokémon take 0.75× as much direct damage from moves while this Pokémon is in battle. This effect stacks if multiple allied Pokémon have it.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.short_desc: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.
frisk.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers. In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.
frisk.flavor_text: The Pokémon can check the foe’s held item.

full-metal-body.name: Full Metal Body
full-metal-body.short_desc: Other Pokémon cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.
full-metal-body.desc: This Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or abilities. This effect only applies to normal stat modifications and not more exotic effects such as Topsy-Turvy or Power Swap. This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.
full-metal-body.flavor_text: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.

gale-wings.name: Gale Wings
gale-wings.short_desc: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.
gale-wings.desc: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.

galvanize.name: Galvanize
galvanize.short_desc: This Pokémon's Normal moves are Electric and have their power increased to 1.2×.
galvanize.desc: When this Pokémon uses a Normal moves, that move is Electric its power is 1.2×.
galvanize.flavor_text: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.short_desc: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.
gluttony.desc: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.
gluttony.flavor_text: Encourages the early use of a held Berry.

good-as-gold.name: Good as Gold
good-as-gold.desc: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.
good-as-gold.flavor_text: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.short_desc: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.
gooey.desc: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.
gooey.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker’s Speed stat.

gorilla-tactics.name: Gorilla Tactics
gorilla-tactics.short_desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
gorilla-tactics.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
gorilla-tactics.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

grass-pelt.name: Grass Pelt
grass-pelt.short_desc: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.
grass-pelt.desc: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.
grass-pelt.flavor_text: Boosts the Defense stat in Grassy Terrain.

grassy-surge.name: Grassy Surge
grassy-surge.short_desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.
grassy-surge.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.
grassy-surge.flavor_text: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

grim-neigh.name: Grim Neigh
grim-neigh.short_desc: Boosts Special Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
grim-neigh.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.
grim-neigh.flavor_text: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

guard-dog.name: Guard Dog
guard-dog.short_desc: Boosts Attack if intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.
guard-dog.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
guard-dog.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

gulp-missile.name: Gulp Missile
gulp-missile.short_desc: If a Cramorant with Gulp Missile uses Surf or Dive, it catches prey and changes its form depending on its remaining HP.
gulp-missile.desc: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
gulp-missile.flavor_text: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

guts.name: Guts
guts.short_desc: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
guts.desc: Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

hadron-engine.name: Hadron Engine
hadron-engine.short_desc: Creates an Electric Terrain when entering battle, and boosts Special Attack while active.
hadron-engine.desc: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
hadron-engine.flavor_text: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.short_desc: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.
harvest.desc: After each turn, if the last item this Pokémon consumed was a Berry and it is not currently holding an item, it has a 50% chance of regaining that Berry, or a 100% chance during strong sunlight.
harvest.flavor_text: May create another Berry after one is used.

healer.name: Healer
healer.short_desc: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.
healer.desc: Friendly Pokémon next to this Pokémon in double and triple battles each have a 30% chance of being cured of any major status ailment after each turn.
healer.flavor_text: May heal an ally’s status conditions.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.short_desc: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.
heatproof.desc: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire-type moves and burns.
heatproof.flavor_text: Weakens the power of Fire-type moves.

heavy-metal.name: Heavy Metal
heavy-metal.desc: This Pokémon has double the usual weight for its species.

honey-gather.name: Honey Gather
honey-gather.short_desc: The Pokémon may pick up Honey after battle.
honey-gather.desc: This Pokémon has a chance of picking up Honey after each battle. This chance starts at 5% and rises another 5% after every tenth level: 5% from level 1–10, 10% from 11–20, and so on, up to 50% from 91–100. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.
honey-gather.flavor_text: The Pokémon may gather Honey from somewhere.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.short_desc: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.
hospitality.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.
hospitality.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

huge-power.name: Huge Power
huge-power.desc: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Pure Power.

hunger-switch.name: Hunger Switch
hunger-switch.short_desc: Causes Morpeko to change its form each turn, alternating between Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode
hunger-switch.desc: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.
hunger-switch.flavor_text: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of each turn.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.short_desc: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.
hustle.desc: This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy. Special moves are unaffected. Moves that do set damage, such as Seismic Toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.short_desc: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
hydration.desc: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
hydration.flavor_text: Heals status problems if it is raining.

hyper-cutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyper-cutter.short_desc: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.
hyper-cutter.desc: This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through Heart Swap or Power Swap.

ice-body.name: Ice Body
ice-body.short_desc: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.
ice-body.desc: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during hail, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.
ice-body.flavor_text: The Pokémon regains HP in a hailstorm.

ice-face.name: Ice Face
ice-face.short_desc: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.
ice-face.desc: When an Eiscue that's in its Ice Face form is hit by a physical move, it takes no damage and changes into its Noice Face form. If a hailstorm or snowstorm begins while Eiscue is in its Noice Face form, or if it is sent out in its Noice Face form during hail, it will immediately revert to its Ice Face form.
ice-face.flavor_text: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it hails.

ice-scales.name: Ice Scales
ice-scales.desc: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.
ice-scales.flavor_text: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.desc: Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled. This ability has no effect in battle.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.short_desc: Takes the appearance of the last conscious party Pokémon upon being sent out until hit by a damaging move.
illusion.desc: This Pokémon, upon being sent out, appears to have the species, nickname, and Poké Ball of the last Pokémon in the party that is able to battle. This illusion breaks upon being hit by a damaging move. Other damage, e.g. from weather or Spikes, does not break the illusion, nor does damage done to a Substitute. If the party order becomes temporarily shuffled around as Pokémon are switched out in battle, this ability chooses the last Pokémon according to that shuffled order.
illusion.flavor_text: Comes out disguised as the Pokémon in back.

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.desc: This Pokémon cannot be poisoned. This includes bad poison. If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.desc: This Pokémon transforms into a random opponent upon entering battle. This effect is identical to the move Transform.
imposter.flavor_text: It transforms itself into the Pokémon it is facing.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.short_desc: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.
infiltrator.desc: This Pokémon's moves ignore Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.
infiltrator.flavor_text: Passes through the foe’s barrier and strikes.

innards-out.name: Innards Out
innards-out.short_desc: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.
innards-out.desc: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.
innards-out.flavor_text: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.desc: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Vital Spirit in battle.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.short_desc: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.
intimidate.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage. In a double battle, both opponents are affected. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle. This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

intrepid-sword.name: Intrepid Sword
intrepid-sword.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
intrepid-sword.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

iron-barbs.name: Iron Barbs
iron-barbs.short_desc: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
iron-barbs.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Rough Skin.
iron-barbs.flavor_text: Inflicts damage to the Pokémon on contact.

iron-fist.name: Iron Fist
iron-fist.short_desc: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.
iron-fist.desc: Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon. Sucker Punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".
iron-fist.flavor_text: Boosts the power of punching moves.

justified.name: Justified
justified.short_desc: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.
justified.desc: Whenever a Dark-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage. The move is not negated in any way.
justified.flavor_text: Raises Attack when hit by a Dark-type move.

keen-eye.name: Keen Eye
keen-eye.desc: This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered. This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate. This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through Heart Swap. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

klutz.name: Klutz
klutz.short_desc: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.
klutz.desc: In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative. This Pokémon also cannot use Fling. The Speed cut from the Iron Ball and the effort items (the Macho Brace, Power Weight, Power Bracer, Power Belt, Power Lens, Power Band, and Power Anklet) is unaffected. Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the Exp. Share, the Amulet Coin, or the Soothe Bell, work as usual. All held items work as usual out of battle. Other moves that use the held item, such as Natural Gift and Switcheroo, work as usual.
klutz.flavor_text: The Pokémon can’t use any held items.

leaf-guard.name: Leaf Guard
leaf-guard.short_desc: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.
leaf-guard.desc: This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight. This ability does not heal prior status ailments. Rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect. Yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.
leaf-guard.flavor_text: Prevents status problems in sunny weather.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost.

libero.name: Libero
libero.short_desc: Libero changes the Pokémon's type to that of its previously used attack.
libero.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
libero.flavor_text: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

light-metal.name: Light Metal
light-metal.desc: This Pokémon has half the usual weight for its species.

lightning-rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning-rod.short_desc: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
lightning-rod.desc: All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability. If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.

limber.name: Limber
limber.desc: This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed. If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

lingering-aroma.name: Lingering Aroma
lingering-aroma.short_desc: Contact changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
lingering-aroma.desc: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Lingering Aroma.
lingering-aroma.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

liquid-ooze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquid-ooze.short_desc: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.
liquid-ooze.desc: Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like Absorb, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain. Dream Eater is unaffected.

liquid-voice.name: Liquid Voice
liquid-voice.desc: When this Pokémon uses a move that is sound-based, that move's type is Water.
liquid-voice.flavor_text: All sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

long-reach.name: Long Reach
long-reach.short_desc: This Pokémon's moves do not make contact.
long-reach.desc: A move used by this Pokémon will not make contact.
long-reach.flavor_text: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

magic-bounce.name: Magic Bounce
magic-bounce.short_desc: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.
magic-bounce.desc: When this Pokémon is targeted by a move flagged as being reflectable, the move is redirected to its user. All reflectable moves are non-damaging, and most non-damaging moves that target other Pokémon are reflectable. A move reflected by this ability or Magic Coat cannot be reflected back.

magic-guard.name: Magic Guard
magic-guard.short_desc: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.
magic-guard.desc: This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move. For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or Spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a Life Orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it. Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, Leech Seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon. The following are unaffected: Struggle, Pain Split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), Belly Drum, Substitute, Curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion. This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with Liquid Ooze. If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.
magic-guard.flavor_text: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

magician.name: Magician
magician.short_desc: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.
magician.desc: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.
magician.flavor_text: The Pokémon steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits with a move.

magma-armor.name: Magma Armor
magma-armor.desc: This Pokémon cannot be frozen. If a Pokémon is frozen and acquires this ability, it will immediately thaw out; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Flame Body.

magnet-pull.name: Magnet Pull
magnet-pull.short_desc: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.
magnet-pull.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.

marvel-scale.name: Marvel Scale
marvel-scale.short_desc: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
marvel-scale.desc: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Defense. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

mega-launcher.name: Mega Launcher
mega-launcher.short_desc: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.
mega-launcher.desc: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.
mega-launcher.flavor_text: Powers up aura and pulse moves.

mega-sol.name: Mega Sol
mega-sol.short_desc: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
mega-sol.desc: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
mega-sol.flavor_text: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.short_desc: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.
merciless.desc: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.
merciless.flavor_text: The Pokémon’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.short_desc: Changes type depending on the terrain.
mimicry.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.
mimicry.flavor_text: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

minds-eye.name: Mind’s Eye
minds-eye.short_desc: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.
minds-eye.desc: Mind's Eye enables the Pokémon with this Ability to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with damage-dealing Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It also prevents other Pokémon from lowering the Pokémon's accuracy and ignores changes to the opponents' evasion.
minds-eye.flavor_text: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves

minus.name: Minus
minus.short_desc: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.
minus.desc: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

mirror-armor.name: Mirror Armor
mirror-armor.desc: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
mirror-armor.flavor_text: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

misty-surge.name: Misty Surge
misty-surge.short_desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.
misty-surge.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.
misty-surge.flavor_text: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

mold-breaker.name: Mold Breaker
mold-breaker.short_desc: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
mold-breaker.desc: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.
mold-breaker.flavor_text: Moves can be used regardless of abilities.

moody.name: Moody
moody.short_desc: Raises a random stat two stages and lowers another one stage after each turn.
moody.desc: After each turn, one of this Pokémon's stats at random rises two stages, and another falls one stage. If a stat is already at 6 or -6 stages, it will not be chosen to be increased or decreased, respectively.
moody.flavor_text: Raises one stat and lowers another.

motor-drive.name: Motor Drive
motor-drive.short_desc: Absorbs Electric moves, raising Speed one stage.
motor-drive.desc: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.
motor-drive.flavor_text: Raises Speed if hit by an Electric-type move.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.short_desc: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.
moxie.desc: This Pokémon's Attack rises one stage upon knocking out another Pokémon, even a friendly Pokémon. This ability does not take effect when the Pokémon indirectly causes another Pokémon to faint, e.g. through poison or Spikes. If this Pokémon knocks out a Pokémon with Mummy, the former's ability will change without taking effect.
moxie.flavor_text: Boosts Attack after knocking out any Pokémon.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.short_desc: Halves damage taken from full HP.
multiscale.desc: This Pokémon takes half as much damage when it is hit having full HP.
multiscale.flavor_text: Reduces damage when HP is full.

multitype.name: Multitype
multitype.short_desc: Changes Arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.
multitype.desc: If this Pokémon is holding an elemental Plate, its type and form change to match the Plate. This Pokémon's held item, whether or not it is a Plate, cannot be taken by Covet or Thief, nor removed by Knock Off, nor traded by Switcheroo or Trick. Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Unlike with Sticky Hold, this Pokémon cannot use Fling, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Arceus. This ability cannot be traded with Skill Swap, nor copied with Role Play or Trace, nor disabled with Gastro Acid, nor changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself. Mold Breaker cannot ignore this ability. If a Pokémon Transforms into an Arceus with this ability, it will Transform into Arceus's default, Normal-type form. If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.
multitype.flavor_text: Changes type to match the held Plate.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.short_desc: Changes attacking Pokémon's abilities to Mummy on contact.
mummy.desc: Whenever a contact move hits this Pokémon, the attacking Pokémon's ability changes to Mummy. Multitype is unaffected. If a Pokémon with Moxie knocks this Pokémon out, the former's ability will change without taking effect.
mummy.flavor_text: Contact with this Pokémon spreads this Ability.

mycelium-might.name: Mycelium Might
mycelium-might.short_desc: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.
mycelium-might.desc: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
mycelium-might.flavor_text: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

natural-cure.name: Natural Cure
natural-cure.short_desc: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.
natural-cure.desc: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon. If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.

neuroforce.name: Neuroforce
neuroforce.flavor_text: Powers up moves that are super effective.

neutralizing-gas.name: Neutralizing Gas
neutralizing-gas.short_desc: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.
neutralizing-gas.desc: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
neutralizing-gas.flavor_text: If the Pokémon with Neutralizing Gas is in the battle, the effects of all Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

no-guard.name: No Guard
no-guard.short_desc: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.
no-guard.desc: Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss. One-hit KO moves are unaffected. Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like Dig or Fly. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
no-guard.flavor_text: Ensures the Pokémon and its foe’s attacks land.

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.short_desc: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act Normal-type.
normalize.desc: This Pokémon's moves all act as if they were Normal-type. Moves that inflict typeless damage do so as usual. Moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, are affected. They otherwise work as usual, however; Weather Ball, for example, is always forced to be Normal, but it still has doubled power and looks different during weather. As Thunder Wave is prevented by immunities, unlike most non-damaging moves, it does not affect Ghost-type Pokémon under the effect of this ability.
normalize.flavor_text: All the Pokémon’s moves become the Normal type.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.short_desc: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.
oblivious.desc: This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate. If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.short_desc: Copies stat boosts by the opponent.
opportunist.desc: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
opportunist.flavor_text: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

orichalcum-pulse.name: Orichalcum Pulse
orichalcum-pulse.short_desc: Turns the sunlight harsh when entering battle, and boosts Attack while active.
orichalcum-pulse.desc: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
orichalcum-pulse.flavor_text: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

overcoat.name: Overcoat
overcoat.desc: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather.
overcoat.flavor_text: Protects the Pokémon from damage from weather.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.short_desc: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
overgrow.desc: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
overgrow.flavor_text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

own-tempo.name: Own Tempo
own-tempo.desc: This Pokémon cannot be confused. If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.

parental-bond.name: Parental Bond
parental-bond.short_desc: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.
parental-bond.desc: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.

pastel-veil.name: Pastel Veil
pastel-veil.short_desc: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being poisoned.
pastel-veil.desc: Prevents the Pokémon and its teammates from being poisoned. It also cures teammates of poisoning when it enters the battlefield.
pastel-veil.flavor_text: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.

perish-body.name: Perish Body
perish-body.short_desc: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
perish-body.desc: When the Pokémon with Perish Body is hit with a contact move, both the attacker and the Pokémon with Perish Body will faint in three turns.
perish-body.flavor_text: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.short_desc: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.
pickpocket.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, if it does not have a held item, it steals the attacker's held item. This Pokémon cannot steal upon being knocked out. It can steal if the attacker has a Substitute, but cannot steal when its own Substitute is hit. If a move hits multiple times, only the last hit triggers this ability. If this Pokémon is wild, it cannot steal from a trained Pokémon.
pickpocket.flavor_text: Steals an item when hit by another Pokémon.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.short_desc: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.
pickup.desc: At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one. After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one. The Air Balloon and Eject Button cannot be picked up. The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

piercing-drill.name: Piercing Drill
piercing-drill.short_desc: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.
piercing-drill.desc: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
piercing-drill.flavor_text: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.short_desc: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Fairy moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
pixilate.desc: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Fairy moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

plus.name: Plus
plus.short_desc: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.
plus.desc: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

poison-heal.name: Poison Heal
poison-heal.short_desc: Heals for 1/8 max HP after each turn when poisoned in place of damage.
poison-heal.desc: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage. This includes bad poison.
poison-heal.flavor_text: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned.

poison-point.name: Poison Point
poison-point.short_desc: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.
poison-point.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

poison-puppeteer.name: Poison Puppeteer
poison-puppeteer.short_desc: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
poison-puppeteer.desc: When a Pokémon is poisoned by any of Pecharunt's moves, it will also become confused.
poison-puppeteer.flavor_text: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

poison-touch.name: Poison Touch
poison-touch.short_desc: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.
poison-touch.desc: This Pokémon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning the target with each hit. This counts as an extra effect for the purposes of Shield Dust. This ability takes effect before Mummy.
poison-touch.flavor_text: May poison targets when a Pokémon makes contact.

power-construct.name: Power Construct
power-construct.short_desc: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%.
power-construct.desc: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Zygarde.
power-construct.flavor_text: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.

power-of-alchemy.name: Power of Alchemy
power-of-alchemy.short_desc: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
power-of-alchemy.desc: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
power-of-alchemy.flavor_text: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

power-spot.name: Power Spot
power-spot.short_desc: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
power-spot.desc: "The power of moves used by the allies of the Pokémon with Power Spot is increased by 30%."
power-spot.flavor_text: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.short_desc: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.
prankster.desc: This Pokémon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by one stage.
prankster.flavor_text: Gives priority to a status move.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.short_desc: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
pressure.desc: Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP. This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

primordial-sea.name: Primordial Sea
primordial-sea.short_desc: Creates heavy rain, which has all the properties of Rain Dance, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Fire moves to fail.
primordial-sea.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes heavy rain. Heavy rain has all the properties of Rain Dance and also causes damaging Fire moves to fail. Heavy rain ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Delta Stream and Desolate Land. Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effects of heavy rain, including allowing Fire moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.
primordial-sea.flavor_text: Affects weather and nullifies any Fire-type attacks.

prism-armor.name: Prism Armor
prism-armor.desc: Super-effective damage this Pokémon takes is reduced to 0.75×. This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.
prism-armor.flavor_text: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

propeller-tail.name: Propeller Tail
propeller-tail.short_desc: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
propeller-tail.desc: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
propeller-tail.flavor_text: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

protean.name: Protean
protean.short_desc: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.
protean.desc: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses. The type change takes place just before the move is used.
protean.flavor_text: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s using.

protosynthesis.name: Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.short_desc: Raises highest stat in harsh sunlight, or if holding Booster Energy.
protosynthesis.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
protosynthesis.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

psychic-surge.name: Psychic Surge
psychic-surge.short_desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.
psychic-surge.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.
psychic-surge.flavor_text: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

punk-rock.name: Punk Rock
punk-rock.short_desc: Boosts sound-based moves and halves damage from the same moves.
punk-rock.desc: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.
punk-rock.flavor_text: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

pure-power.name: Pure Power
pure-power.desc: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Huge Power.

purifying-salt.name: Purifying Salt
purifying-salt.short_desc: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.
purifying-salt.desc: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
purifying-salt.flavor_text: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

quark-drive.name: Quark Drive
quark-drive.short_desc: Raises highest stat on Electric Terrain, or if holding Booster Energy.
quark-drive.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
quark-drive.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

queenly-majesty.name: Queenly Majesty
queenly-majesty.short_desc: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.
queenly-majesty.desc: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.
queenly-majesty.flavor_text: Its majesty pressures the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.

quick-draw.name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.short_desc: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
quick-draw.desc: If a Pokémon with this Ability selects a damaging move, it has a 30% chance of going first in its priority bracket.
quick-draw.flavor_text: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

quick-feet.name: Quick Feet
quick-feet.short_desc: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
quick-feet.desc: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.
quick-feet.flavor_text: Boosts Speed if there is a status problem.

rain-dish.name: Rain Dish
rain-dish.short_desc: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.
rain-dish.desc: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.

rattled.name: Rattled
rattled.short_desc: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.
rattled.desc: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage with each hit from a damaging Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type move.
rattled.flavor_text: Some move types scare it and boost its Speed.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.short_desc: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
receiver.desc: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
receiver.flavor_text: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.short_desc: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.
reckless.desc: This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power. Struggle is unaffected. The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: Jump Kick and High Jump Kick.
reckless.flavor_text: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

refrigerate.name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.short_desc: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Ice moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
refrigerate.desc: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Ice-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.short_desc: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.
regenerator.desc: This Pokémon regains 1/3 of its maximum HP when it is switched out for another Pokémon under any circumstances other than having fainted. This ability does not take effect when a battle ends.
regenerator.flavor_text: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.

ripen.name: Ripen
ripen.desc: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
ripen.flavor_text: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.short_desc: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.
rivalry.desc: This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender. If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.
rivalry.flavor_text: Raises Attack if the foe is of the same gender.

rks-system.name: RKS System
rks-system.short_desc: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory.
rks-system.desc: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory. This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified. This ability only takes effect for Silvally.
rks-system.flavor_text: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.

rock-head.name: Rock Head
rock-head.desc: This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves. Struggle's recoil is unaffected. This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick.

rocky-payload.name: Rocky Payload
rocky-payload.desc: Increases the power of Rock-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

rough-skin.name: Rough Skin
rough-skin.short_desc: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
rough-skin.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Iron Barbs.

run-away.name: Run Away
run-away.short_desc: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
run-away.desc: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.
run-away.flavor_text: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

sand-force.name: Sand Force
sand-force.short_desc: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
sand-force.desc: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves have 1.3× their base power. This Pokémon does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.
