sand-force.flavor_text: Boosts certain moves’ power in a sandstorm.

sand-rush.name: Sand Rush
sand-rush.short_desc: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
sand-rush.desc: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during a sandstorm, and it does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.
sand-rush.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed in a sandstorm.

sand-spit.name: Sand Spit
sand-spit.short_desc: Creates a sandstorm when hit by an attack.
sand-spit.desc: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.
sand-spit.flavor_text: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.

sand-stream.name: Sand Stream
sand-stream.short_desc: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
sand-stream.desc: The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

sand-veil.name: Sand Veil
sand-veil.short_desc: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
sand-veil.desc: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

sap-sipper.name: Sap Sipper
sap-sipper.short_desc: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.
sap-sipper.desc: Whenever a Grass-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage, negating any other effect on it.
sap-sipper.flavor_text: Boosts Attack when hit by a Grass-type move.

schooling.name: Schooling
schooling.short_desc: Wishiwashi becomes Schooling Form when its HP is 25% or higher.
schooling.desc: If this Pokémon is a Wishiwashi and level 20 or above, then when it enters battle and at the start of each turn, it becomes Schooling Form if its HP is 25% or higher and Solo Form otherwise. This ability cannot be replaced, copied, or nullified.
schooling.flavor_text: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.short_desc: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.
scrappy.desc: This Pokémon ignores Ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.
scrappy.flavor_text: Enables moves to hit Ghost-type foes.

screen-cleaner.name: Screen Cleaner
screen-cleaner.short_desc: Nullifies effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.
screen-cleaner.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
screen-cleaner.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

seed-sower.name: Seed Sower
seed-sower.short_desc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
seed-sower.desc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
seed-sower.flavor_text: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

serene-grace.name: Serene Grace
serene-grace.short_desc: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.
serene-grace.desc: This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but Protect's chance of success and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected. Secret Power is unaffected.

shadow-shield.name: Shadow Shield
shadow-shield.short_desc: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage from moves is halved.
shadow-shield.desc: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage (not fixed damage!) from moves is halved. This ability cannot be nullified.
shadow-shield.flavor_text: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

shadow-tag.name: Shadow Tag
shadow-tag.short_desc: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.
shadow-tag.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.

sharpness.name: Sharpness
sharpness.desc: Increases the power of all 'slicing' moves by 50%.

shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.short_desc: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.
shed-skin.desc: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.

sheer-force.name: Sheer Force
sheer-force.short_desc: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.
sheer-force.desc: This Pokémon's moves with extra effects have 1.3× their power, but lose their extra effects. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate. Moves that lower the user's stats are unaffected.
sheer-force.flavor_text: Removes added effects to increase move damage.

shell-armor.name: Shell Armor
shell-armor.desc: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Battle Armor.

shield-dust.name: Shield Dust
shield-dust.short_desc: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
shield-dust.desc: This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it. An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.

shields-down.name: Shields Down
shields-down.short_desc: Transforms this Minior between Core Form and Meteor Form. Prevents major status ailments and drowsiness while in Meteor Form.
shields-down.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle and at the end of each turn, if its HP is 50% or above, it changes into Meteor Form; otherwise, it changes into Core Form. In Meteor Form, it cannot be given a major status ailment (though existing ones are not cured), cannot become drowsy from Yawn, and cannot use Rest (which will simply fail). This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified. This ability only takes effect for Minior.
shields-down.flavor_text: When its HP becomes half or less, the Pokémon’s shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.

simple.name: Simple
simple.short_desc: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers. These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.
simple.desc: Each stage of this Pokémon's stat modifiers acts as two stages. These doubled stages are still limited to a minimum of -6 and a maximum of 6. This Pokémon can still accumulate less than -3 or more than 3 stages of stat modifiers, even though the extra ones have no effect after doubling.
simple.flavor_text: The Pokémon is prone to wild stat changes.

skill-link.name: Skill Link
skill-link.short_desc: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.
skill-link.desc: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear. It also bypasses the accuracy checks on Triple Kick's second and third hits.
skill-link.flavor_text: Increases the frequency of multi-strike moves.

slow-start.name: Slow Start
slow-start.short_desc: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.
slow-start.desc: This Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved for five turns upon entering battle. This ability also takes effect when acquired during battle. If this Pokémon loses its ability before the five turns are up, its Attack and Speed return to normal; if it then regains this ability without leaving battle, its Attack and Speed are halved again, but the counter keeps counting from where it was.

slush-rush.name: Slush Rush
slush-rush.short_desc: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.
slush-rush.desc: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.
slush-rush.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a hailstorm.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.short_desc: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.
sniper.desc: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.
sniper.flavor_text: Powers up moves if they become critical hits.

snow-cloak.name: Snow Cloak
snow-cloak.short_desc: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.
snow-cloak.desc: During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.

snow-warning.name: Snow Warning
snow-warning.short_desc: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
snow-warning.desc: The weather changes to hail when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Sand Stream are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
snow-warning.flavor_text: The Pokémon summons a hailstorm in battle.

solar-power.name: Solar Power
solar-power.short_desc: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.
solar-power.desc: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.
solar-power.flavor_text: Boosts Sp. Atk, but lowers HP in sunshine.

solid-rock.name: Solid Rock
solid-rock.short_desc: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
solid-rock.desc: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Filter.

soul-heart.name: Soul-Heart
soul-heart.short_desc: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.
soul-heart.desc: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.
soul-heart.flavor_text: Boosts its Sp. Atk stat every time a Pokémon faints.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.desc: This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. Heal Bell is unaffected. Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used. Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based.

speed-boost.name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.short_desc: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.
speed-boost.desc: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.

spicy-spray.name: Spicy Spray
spicy-spray.short_desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
spicy-spray.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
spicy-spray.flavor_text: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

stakeout.name: Stakeout
stakeout.short_desc: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.
stakeout.desc: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.
stakeout.flavor_text: Doubles the damage dealt to the target’s replacement if the target switches out.

stall.name: Stall
stall.short_desc: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.
stall.desc: This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket. Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves. The Full Incense and Lagging Tail take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability. Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item. This ability works as usual during Trick Room: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.
stall.flavor_text: The Pokémon moves after even slower foes.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.short_desc: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
stalwart.desc: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
stalwart.flavor_text: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.short_desc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.
stamina.desc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.
stamina.flavor_text: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.

stance-change.name: Stance Change
stance-change.short_desc: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.
stance-change.desc: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.
stance-change.flavor_text: The Pokémon changes form depending on how it battles.

static.name: Static
static.short_desc: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
static.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed. Pokémon that are immune to Electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an Electric Pokémon, if applicable.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.short_desc: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.
steadfast.desc: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.
steadfast.flavor_text: Raises Speed each time the Pokémon flinches.

steam-engine.name: Steam Engine
steam-engine.short_desc: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
steam-engine.desc: Raises the user's Speed by three stages when it is hit by a Fire- or Water-type attack. The attack still deals damage.
steam-engine.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat drastically if hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

steelworker.name: Steelworker
steelworker.short_desc: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.
steelworker.desc: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.

steely-spirit.name: Steely Spirit
steely-spirit.short_desc: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.
steely-spirit.desc: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
steely-spirit.flavor_text: Powers up ally Pokémon’s Steel-type moves.

stench.name: Stench
stench.short_desc: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.
stench.desc: This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect. This ability does not stack with a held item. Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.

sticky-hold.name: Sticky Hold
sticky-hold.short_desc: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.
sticky-hold.desc: This Pokémon's hold item cannot be removed by other Pokémon. Damaging moves that would remove this Pokémon's item can still inflict damage against this Pokémon, e.g. Knock Off or Pluck. This Pokémon can still use moves that involve the loss of its own item, e.g. Fling or Trick. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the encounter rate while fishing is increased.

storm-drain.name: Storm Drain
storm-drain.short_desc: Redirects single-target Water moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
storm-drain.desc: All other Pokémon's single-target Water-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon, if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Water moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability.
storm-drain.flavor_text: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves.

strong-jaw.name: Strong Jaw
strong-jaw.short_desc: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.
strong-jaw.desc: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.
strong-jaw.flavor_text: The Pokémon’s strong jaw gives it tremendous biting power.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.short_desc: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.
sturdy.desc: When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP. Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold. If this Pokémon is holding a Focus Sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.

suction-cups.name: Suction Cups
suction-cups.short_desc: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.
suction-cups.desc: This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as Whirlwind. Dragon Tail and Circle Throw still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased.

super-luck.name: Super Luck
super-luck.short_desc: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
super-luck.desc: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.
super-luck.flavor_text: Heightens the critical-hit ratios of moves.

supersweet-syrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweet-syrup.short_desc: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.
supersweet-syrup.desc: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.
supersweet-syrup.flavor_text: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

supreme-overlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supreme-overlord.short_desc: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.
supreme-overlord.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
supreme-overlord.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

surge-surfer.name: Surge Surfer
surge-surfer.short_desc: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.
surge-surfer.desc: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.
surge-surfer.flavor_text: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.short_desc: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
swarm.desc: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.
swarm.flavor_text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

sweet-veil.name: Sweet Veil
sweet-veil.flavor_text: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.

swift-swim.name: Swift Swim
swift-swim.desc: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

sword-of-ruin.name: Sword of Ruin
sword-of-ruin.short_desc: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
sword-of-ruin.desc: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
sword-of-ruin.flavor_text: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.short_desc: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.
symbiosis.desc: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.
symbiosis.flavor_text: The Pokémon can pass an item to an ally.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.short_desc: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
synchronize.desc: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.

tablets-of-ruin.name: Tablets of Ruin
tablets-of-ruin.short_desc: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
tablets-of-ruin.desc: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
tablets-of-ruin.flavor_text: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

tangled-feet.name: Tangled Feet
tangled-feet.desc: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.
tangled-feet.flavor_text: Raises evasion if the Pokémon is confused.

tangling-hair.name: Tangling Hair
tangling-hair.short_desc: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.
tangling-hair.desc: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.
tangling-hair.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker’s Speed stat.

technician.name: Technician
technician.short_desc: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.
technician.desc: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less. This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.
technician.flavor_text: Powers up the Pokémon’s weaker moves.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.short_desc: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
telepathy.desc: This Pokémon does not take damage from friendly Pokémon's moves, including single-target moves aimed at it.
telepathy.flavor_text: Anticipates an ally’s attack and dodges it.

tera-shell.name: Tera Shell
tera-shell.short_desc: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
tera-shell.desc: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
tera-shell.flavor_text: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

tera-shift.name: Tera Shift
tera-shift.short_desc: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.
tera-shift.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
tera-shift.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

teraform-zero.name: Teraform Zero
teraform-zero.short_desc: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.
teraform-zero.desc: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
teraform-zero.flavor_text: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

teravolt.name: Teravolt
teravolt.short_desc: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
teravolt.desc: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Mold Breaker and Turboblaze.
teravolt.flavor_text: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.

thermal-exchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermal-exchange.short_desc: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.
thermal-exchange.desc: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
thermal-exchange.flavor_text: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

thick-fat.name: Thick Fat
thick-fat.short_desc: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
thick-fat.desc: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

tinted-lens.name: Tinted Lens
tinted-lens.short_desc: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
tinted-lens.desc: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.short_desc: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
torrent.desc: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
torrent.flavor_text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

tough-claws.name: Tough Claws
tough-claws.short_desc: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.
tough-claws.desc: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.
tough-claws.flavor_text: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

toxic-boost.name: Toxic Boost
toxic-boost.desc: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Attack when poisoned.
toxic-boost.flavor_text: Powers up physical attacks when poisoned.

toxic-chain.name: Toxic Chain
toxic-chain.short_desc: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.
toxic-chain.desc: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.
toxic-chain.flavor_text: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move

toxic-debris.name: Toxic Debris
toxic-debris.short_desc: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
toxic-debris.desc: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
toxic-debris.flavor_text: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

trace.name: Trace
trace.short_desc: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.
trace.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.desc: Increases the power of Electric-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

triage.name: Triage
triage.short_desc: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
triage.desc: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
triage.flavor_text: Gives priority to a healing move.

truant.name: Truant
truant.desc: Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around"). Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do. Most such moves, for example Bide or Rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around. Attacks with a recharge turn, such as Hyper Beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as Fly, do not end up being used. Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as Outrage, Uproar, or any move forced by Encore, keep going as usual. If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending. If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or Gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn. If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did. This ability cannot be changed with Worry Seed, but it can be disabled with Gastro Acid, changed with Role Play, or traded away with Skill Swap.

turboblaze.name: Turboblaze
turboblaze.short_desc: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
turboblaze.desc: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Mold Breaker and Teravolt.
turboblaze.flavor_text: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.short_desc: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.
unaware.desc: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation. Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed. The power of Punishment and Stored Power is calculated as usual. When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.
unaware.flavor_text: Ignores any change in ability by the foe.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.short_desc: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
unburden.desc: When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled. If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost. This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of Knock Off. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. There is no notification when this ability takes effect.
unburden.flavor_text: Raises Speed if a held item is used.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.short_desc: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
unnerve.desc: Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry.
unnerve.flavor_text: Makes the foe nervous and unable to eat Berries.

unseen-fist.name: Unseen Fist
unseen-fist.short_desc: Contact moves can strike through Protect/Detect.
unseen-fist.desc: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.
unseen-fist.flavor_text: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

vessel-of-ruin.name: Vessel of Ruin
vessel-of-ruin.short_desc: Lowers Special Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
vessel-of-ruin.desc: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
vessel-of-ruin.flavor_text: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

victory-star.name: Victory Star
victory-star.short_desc: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.1× for friendly Pokémon.
victory-star.desc: All friendly Pokémon's moves, including this Pokémon's own moves, have 1.1× their usual accuracy while this Pokémon is in battle.
victory-star.flavor_text: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.

vital-spirit.name: Vital Spirit
vital-spirit.desc: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Insomnia in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

volt-absorb.name: Volt Absorb
volt-absorb.short_desc: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
volt-absorb.desc: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.

wandering-spirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wandering-spirit.short_desc: Swaps abilities with opponents on contact.
wandering-spirit.desc: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
wandering-spirit.flavor_text: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

water-absorb.name: Water Absorb
water-absorb.short_desc: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
water-absorb.desc: Whenever a Water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.

water-bubble.name: Water Bubble
water-bubble.short_desc: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.
water-bubble.desc: When this Pokémon is hit by a Fire move, the damage is halved. When this Pokémon uses a Water move, the power is doubled. This Pokémon cannot be burned, and if it becomes burned, the burn is immediately cured.
water-bubble.flavor_text: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves done to the Pokémon and prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

water-compaction.name: Water Compaction
water-compaction.short_desc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.
water-compaction.desc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.
water-compaction.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat sharply when hit by a Water-type move.

water-veil.name: Water Veil
water-veil.desc: This Pokémon cannot be burned. If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

weak-armor.name: Weak Armor
weak-armor.short_desc: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.
weak-armor.desc: Whenever a physical move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage and its Defense falls one stage. This ability triggers on every hit of a multiple-hit move.
weak-armor.flavor_text: Physical attacks lower Defense and raise Speed.

well-baked-body.name: Well-Baked Body
well-baked-body.short_desc: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.
well-baked-body.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
well-baked-body.flavor_text: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

white-smoke.name: White Smoke
white-smoke.short_desc: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
white-smoke.desc: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis; nor self-inflicted stat drops, such as the Special Attack drop from Overheat; nor opponent-triggered stat boosts, such as the Attack boost from Swagger. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to Clear Body in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

wimp-out.name: Wimp Out
wimp-out.short_desc: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.
wimp-out.desc: After this Pokémon is hit by a move, if that move caused this Pokémon's HP to drop below half, it switches out.
wimp-out.flavor_text: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

wind-power.name: Wind Power
wind-power.short_desc: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
wind-power.desc: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
wind-power.flavor_text: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

wind-rider.name: Wind Rider
wind-rider.short_desc: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.
wind-rider.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
wind-rider.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

wonder-guard.name: Wonder Guard
wonder-guard.short_desc: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.
wonder-guard.desc: This Pokémon is immune to damaging moves that are not super effective against it. Moves that inflict fixed damage, such as Night Shade or Seismic Toss, are considered super effective if their types are. Damage not directly dealt by moves, such as damage from weather, a status ailment, or Spikes, is not prevented. This ability cannot be copied with Role Play or traded away with Skill Swap, but it can be copied with Trace, disabled with Gastro Acid, or changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon can still use Role Play itself to lose this ability, but not Skill Swap. If this Pokémon has a Substitute, this ability will block moves as usual and any moves not blocked will react to the Substitute as usual.

wonder-skin.name: Wonder Skin
wonder-skin.short_desc: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.
wonder-skin.desc: Non-damaging moves have exactly 50% base accuracy against this Pokémon.
wonder-skin.flavor_text: Makes status-changing moves more likely to miss.

zen-mode.name: Zen Mode
zen-mode.short_desc: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.
zen-mode.desc: This Pokémon switches between Standard Mode and Zen Mode after each turn depending on its HP. Below 50% of its maximum HP, it switches to Zen Mode, and at 50% or above, it switches to Standard Mode. This Pokémon returns to Standard Mode upon leaving battle or losing this ability. This ability has no effect if this Pokémon is not a Darmanitan.
zen-mode.flavor_text: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is halved.

zero-to-hero.name: Zero to Hero
zero-to-hero.short_desc: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.
zero-to-hero.desc: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
zero-to-hero.flavor_text: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
